create_ProposalModule: create a ProposalModule for 3D object proposal generation with vote clustering and farthest point sampling
run_ProposalModule_forward: run the ProposalModule forward pass with xyz coordinates, features, and end_points to generate object proposals
decode_scores: decode proposal network outputs into objectness scores, center, heading, size, and semantic classification predictions
sample_votes_vote_fps: sample vote proposals using farthest point sampling on aggregated vote coordinates
sample_votes_seed_fps: sample vote proposals by applying farthest point sampling on seed points and selecting corresponding votes
